description: Combination screen from the unsmoothed multiscale-feature square-root/local-noise sampled MLP: shape_no_calendar removes annual calendar while using finalized admissions/flu-ED training histories; shape_artificial keeps calendar but perturbs those histories with synchronous_phase_log reporting errors from permitted training seasons, no added missingness. Both learn 36 future finalized weekly admissions and flu-ED labels with unchanged weekly/path/peak losses, no added timing log loss. Each held-out fold uses the other three seasons among 2022-23 through 2025-26, two seeds44/45. Strict archived Wednesday evaluation without finalized fills, final NHSN peak labels, common state/DC tasks in 2024-25/2025-26. Retrospective development, not untouched validation.
